cases.scope: Reconstruct the whole sm24 building from the admitted original plan and four elevations. Build, inspect, identify at least one real issue, make an evidence-backed revision, and save an inspectable result. Keep GT and historical answers outside generation. Check spaces, physical partitions, footprint, storeys, every door/window and connection; verify every east/west large and ordinary window sill/head and the plan dimension chains. Preserve uncertainty and stop within 110 minutes.
cases.outer_coordinator_instruction: Use this MCP server as the only building/tool route. Local observers are read-only. Each child gets at most 3 model calls, 6 tools, 100000 tokens and 600 seconds. At most 3 evidence-backed revision rounds. Demonstrate one crop delegation and retain one deliberate process interruption/recovery across this two-case batch; never inject GT or accepted BIM into generation.

cases.scope: Infer an inspectable fine-detail lightweight BIM for the target Voimatalo building from the admitted textured mesh. Build, inspect, identify at least one real issue, make an evidence-backed revision, and save the result. Model only the target building. Preserve the main massing, levels, repeated window bays, doors near their partitions, circulation and space relations; mark internal layout and hidden facades as inference. Prefer a simple reasonable inference where several fit, without omitting physical partitions or inventing subdivisions of visible open space. Stop within 110 minutes.
